main.title: unset.sh profile and pages
main.detail: Create and update your unset.sh profile, sections and pages, and your follows of unset.sh accounts, in your account. Nothing else in your account.

main.description: Everything unset.sh writes under sh.unset.* in a member's repository. Changing this set changes every existing grant at its next refresh: additions need Alex's approval, removals are refused.
